title: NVIDIA FY2023 Q4 results
summary: NVIDIA Q4 FY23 Data Center revenue was $3.62B, before the post-ChatGPT AI infrastructure acceleration showed up in reported platform revenue.

title: NVIDIA FY2024 Q4 results
summary: NVIDIA Q4 FY24 Data Center revenue was $18.4B, showing the first large financial step-change after accelerated computing demand surged.

title: NVIDIA FY2025 Q4 results
summary: NVIDIA Q4 FY25 Data Center revenue was $35.6B, extending the AI infrastructure revenue ramp before Blackwell scaled further.

title: NVIDIA FY2026 Q4 results
summary: NVIDIA Q4 FY26 revenue was $68.1B, Data Center revenue was $62.3B, and management framed customer demand as AI factories for the AI industrial revolution.

title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform at GTC 2026
summary: NVIDIA announced Vera Rubin as seven chips and five rack-scale systems for AI factories, covering Vera CPU, Rubin GPU, NVLink 6, ConnectX-9, BlueField-4, Spectrum-6 and Groq 3 LPU.

title: NVIDIA Dynamo 1.0 for AI factory inference
summary: NVIDIA announced Dynamo 1.0 as open-source production software for AI factory inference orchestration, with reported up to 7x Blackwell inference performance improvement and broad cloud/provider adoption.

title: Vertiv Q4 2025 results
summary: Vertiv Q4 2025 organic orders rose about 252% YoY and backlog reached $15.0B, reflecting robust AI infrastructure demand.

title: Dell FY2026 Q4 results
summary: Dell FY26 closed more than $64B in AI-optimized server orders, shipped more than $25B, entered FY27 with a $43B backlog, and guided FY27 AI-optimized server revenue to roughly $50B, up 103% year over year.

title: Astera Labs Q4 2025 results
summary: Astera Labs Q4 revenue was $270.6M, +92% YoY, tied to rack-scale AI infrastructure connectivity.

title: Credo FY2026 Q3 results
summary: Credo FY26 Q3 revenue was $407.0M, +200% YoY, with active electrical cables, optical interconnects and memory connectivity tied to AI infrastructure.

title: Marvell FY2026 Q3 10-Q
summary: Marvell FY26 Q3 net revenue was $2.075B; data-center sales increased 38% year over year, driven by AI-related demand for custom products and electro-optics.

title: Broadcom FY2025 Q4 results
summary: Broadcom Q4 FY25 AI semiconductor revenue rose 74% YoY and Q1 FY26 AI semiconductor revenue was expected to double to $8.2B, driven by custom AI accelerators and Ethernet AI switches.

title: Arista Q4 2025 results
summary: Arista FY2025 revenue was $9.006B, +28.6%, and management said it exceeded AI networking and campus expansion goals.

title: TSMC Q4 2025 results
summary: TSMC Q4 2025 revenue was $33.73B, gross margin 62.3%, advanced technologies were 77% of wafer revenue, and 2026 capex was expected at $52B-$56B.

title: Micron FY2026 Q1 results
summary: Micron FY26 Q1 delivered record revenue and margin expansion, with AI data-center memory demand driving cloud memory and HBM-related strength.

title: Micron FY2026 Q1 prepared remarks
summary: Micron prepared remarks forecast HBM TAM from about $35B in calendar 2025 to around $100B in calendar 2028, about 40% CAGR, and said 2026 HBM supply had completed price and volume agreements.

title: SK hynix FY2025 results
summary: SK hynix FY2025 revenue was KRW97.1467T, operating profit KRW47.2063T and operating margin 49%, driven by AI memory and HBM leadership.

title: Samsung Q4 and FY2025 results
summary: Samsung Q4 2025 Memory Business reached record quarterly revenue and operating profit, with HBM, server DDR5 and enterprise SSD as high-value AI products.

title: Supermicro FY2026 Q2 results
summary: Supermicro remained an AI server assembly exposure, but margin, execution and governance risks require a lower risk-control score.

title: Microsoft FY2026 Q2 results
summary: Microsoft Q2 FY2026 Microsoft Cloud revenue was $51.5B, +26%, commercial RPO increased 110% to $625B, and Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 39%.

title: Amazon Q4 2025 results
summary: Amazon Q4 2025 AWS segment sales increased to $35.6B and TTM purchases of property and equipment reached $128.3B, while FCF fell as infrastructure investment intensified.

title: Alphabet Q4 2025 results
summary: Alphabet Q4 2025 Google Cloud revenue increased 48% to $17.7B, Cloud annual run rate exceeded $70B, and 2026 CapEx was anticipated at $175B-$185B to meet customer demand.

title: Meta Q3 2025 results
summary: Meta Q3 2025 capex was $19.37B; 2025 capex guidance was $70B-$72B and management expected 2026 capex dollar growth to be notably larger, driven by infrastructure capacity needs.

title: Oracle FY2026 Q2 results
summary: Oracle Q2 FY2026 RPO was $523B, +438%; cloud revenue was $8.0B, +34%; TTM capex was $35.5B and FCF was negative $13.2B after heavy cloud infrastructure investment.

title: TIME: ChatGPT 100M users in two months
summary: TIME cited Similarweb and UBS data that ChatGPT reached about 100M monthly active users in January 2023, two months after launch.

title: The Verge: ChatGPT 200M weekly users
summary: The Verge reported OpenAI confirmed ChatGPT had more than 200M weekly users in August 2024, double the 100M weekly active users reported in November 2023.

title: Windows Central: ChatGPT weekly users and prompt volume
summary: Windows Central reported ChatGPT was on track to reach 700M weekly active users in August 2025, about 4x year over year, with an estimated 2.5B-3.0B prompts per day.

title: Economic Times: OpenAI DevDay 2025 ChatGPT apps
summary: Economic Times reported OpenAI said ChatGPT weekly users surpassed 800M at DevDay 2025, alongside the launch of apps inside ChatGPT.

title: SemiAnalysis AI Capacity Constraints CoWoS and HBM Supply Chain
summary: SemiAnalysis identified CoWoS and HBM as AI accelerator bottlenecks and explained CoWoS as TSMC 2.5D packaging that integrates logic and HBM on an interposer.

title: SemiAnalysis GB200 Hardware Architecture Component Supply Chain and BOM
summary: SemiAnalysis mapped GB200 rack-scale architecture and component implications, including that many data centers cannot support very high rack density without direct-to-chip liquid cooling.

title: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Anatomy Part 2 Cooling Systems
summary: SemiAnalysis described data-center cooling as one of the fastest-evolving AI infrastructure markets and argued liquid-cooling demand is underestimated in chip-by-chip capacity models.

title: SemiAnalysis Nvidia Optical Boogeyman NVL72 Infiniband Scale Out 800G and 1.6T Ramp
summary: SemiAnalysis linked Blackwell NVL72 system architecture, NVLink scale-up, InfiniBand scale-out, 800G and 1.6T ramps to optical and networking BOM expansion.

title: TrendForce HBM Prices to Increase by 5-10% in 2025
summary: TrendForce estimated HBM ASP at several times conventional DRAM and about five times DDR5, while value share could exceed 30% of DRAM in 2025.

title: TrendForce Blackwell Ultra and B200A HBM3e 12hi Consumption
summary: TrendForce described NVIDIA as the largest HBM buyer, expected procurement share above 70%, with HBM consumption growing more than 200% in 2024 and expected to double again in 2025 as Blackwell raises HBM content.

title: Omdia AI Data Center Chip Market Forecast
summary: Omdia forecast cloud and data-center AI processor spending from about $123B in 2024 to $207B in 2025 and $286B by 2030, with custom ASICs gaining share alongside GPUs.

title: Omdia 2026 Trends to Watch Semiconductors
summary: Omdia tied AI semiconductor growth to GPUs, logic ASICs, HBM, power-management ICs, advanced nodes, chiplets and silicon photonics, while flagging infrastructure and supply constraints.

title: LightCounting Optics for AI Clusters
summary: LightCounting estimated AI-cluster optical transceiver, LPO and CPO demand rising from about $5B in 2024 to more than $10B in 2026, with scale-up and scale-out models through 2030.

title: LightCounting AI Capex Flows Down the Supply Chain to DSP Vendors
summary: LightCounting reported AI infrastructure capex drove 800G PAM4 chipset shipments to nearly triple in 2025 and expected 800G shipments to more than double in 2026, with 1.6T ports ramping from a small base.

title: Dell'Oro Group Ethernet AI Backend Network Forecast
summary: Dell'Oro Group forecast AI back-end networks could drive nearly $80B of data-center switch sales over five years and expected Ethernet to gain share from InfiniBand in AI back-end networks.

title: Dell'Oro Group Data Center Liquid Cooling Forecast
summary: Dell'Oro Group forecast data-center liquid-cooling manufacturer revenue near $3B in 2025 and approaching $7B by 2029, with hyperscalers anchoring demand and direct liquid cooling leading adoption.
